description: Starts a backup of the server’s system disk now (the option must be enabled; at most 2 manual backups kept). The server is BRIEFLY INTERRUPTED (shut down then restarted automatically, a few minutes). Two steps: call without confirmationToken to get the warning and a token, ask the user, then call again with the token. (permission: servers:backup) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous call without token, valid 10 minutes, single use.

name: gpucloud_create_server_backup
title: Back up a server now
